name: codocs
description: Root convenience scripts. api/ and web/ are independent npm projects.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix api install && npm --prefix web install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm --prefix api run dev" "npm --prefix web run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix api run build && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix api run typecheck && npm --prefix web run typecheck
